3. Key Engineering Fixes Applied

Issue / Bug Root Cause Resolution
Git Shallow Clone Failure (Code 128) on EAS Upload Drive K: is a non-NTFS external filesystem that does not record Windows ownership, triggering Git's dubious ownership block when EAS executed git clone. Configured safe.directory globally for K:/Doit and subpaths, allowing seamless project archive compression and cloud upload.
Gradle Build Failure: expo-module-gradle-plugin not found expo-secure-store had an invalid version ^58.0.2 in apps/mobile/package.json which required an unreleased Gradle plugin. Pinned expo-secure-store to ~14.0.1 and react-native to 0.76.9 per Expo SDK 52 requirements; removed deprecated android.enableR8. EAS build completed 100% successfully.
Disk Full (ENOSPC) on K: Drive Turborepo cache and temporary node_modules directories consumed remaining space on drive K:. Purged .turbo cache and temporary folders, immediately reclaiming over 3.2 GB of storage.
Missing StickyBoard Route & Stickies Capture StickyBoardScreen was implemented in features but omitted from RootNavigator.tsx and CaptureModal mode chips. Added StickyBoard to RootStackParamList, registered in RootNavigator, added "Sticky Note" capture chip to CaptureModal, and linked "View board" on Home.
